newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse rises, banks, Ashanti among gainers.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse rises, banks, Ashanti among gainers.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index rose in its first session of the week, with banks and Ashanti Goldfields Company among those leading the way, its market report showed.
After sliding throughout last week, the index rose seven points to 353.66 points in its Monday (eds correct) session.
Volume was 146,010 shares trades, well down on Friday's 454,630 shares. Offers outstripped demand by 2,687,410 to 1,385,910.
Social Security Bank SSB.GH (+110 cedis to 1,200 cedis) and Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH (+10 to 640) both rose on Monday, after rising on Friday.
Ashanti (+15 to 20,815), UNILEVER (+15 to 775), and Accra Brewery Limited ABL.GH (+1 to 595) were the other risers.
Home Finance Company (-5 to 135) was the lone faller.
